items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: and I knew his first wife real well. She was a singer. Melrose Rose was her name.

ctx.x: (Inaudible). But Ray was from Chicago, and he used to play on the South Side there for the great Ben Escola, and he played on the North Side with that 5100 Club (inaudible) that I was telling you about that I think Danny Thomas was there. And this is where Duke first heard him, and he came out and offered him a job. Do you know Ray turned him down? Man, when we heard about it, we got so mad, we had to almost quit speaking to him before he would go. He was that loyal to the group, you know. Oh, he played, and he…
talked Ray into going. You know the story after that.
